mapper.update: INSERT INTO item_info (merge_key, value, is_industry, deleted) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{value}, #{isIndustry}, false) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, is_industry = EXCLUDED.is_industry, deleted = false WHERE ( item_info.value, item_info.is_industry, item_info.deleted ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.value, EXCLUDED.is_industry, false )

INSERT INTO company_item ( company_id, info_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id ) SELECT c.company_id, i.info_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN item_info i ON i.merge_key = #{dto.mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{dto.corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, info_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE company_item.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR company_item.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_item ci SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE ci.deleted = false AND ci.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )

UPDATE company_item ci SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE ci.deleted = false AND ci.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ) AND ci.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
